column1: # Tinkero package name map: Arch package name (as upstream's scripts and menu guards use it),
# kind, target. kind: dnf (Fedora or Tinkero COPR package), flatpak (Flathub application id),
# none (no route yet: the wrappers explain how to install by hand). One row per name that the
# payload passes to omarchy-pkg-add/drop/present/missing, directly or through
# omarchy-install-app, -and-launch and -font; ci/gate-name-map enforces that. Names that
# reach a wrapper only through a shell variable (the Ollama trio in the menu) are listed by hand.
# Keep the rows sorted by name. Tab-separated.
